reuse.why: Extends the existing applyWeekendRule, getDateWithSkippedWeekend and isDailyWeekendSkip helpers and threads holidays through every existing caller instead of adding parallel logic.

duplication.why: The off-day test is defined once (isOffDay), but the '+ holidays.length' search-window padding heuristic is repeated in getNextDate, getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange.

placement.why: isOffDay and the move loop live in shared/schedules.ts next to the existing weekend rule; server code only passes config.holidays.

scope.why: Only the holidays field, its threading and the off-day rule are touched.

maintainability.why: The weekend/holiday rule is centralised; the remaining wart is the repeated window-size heuristic and the per-caller daily filter that pre-existed.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All weekend handling goes through applyWeekendRule/isOffDay; no call site re-implements it.

disguised_duplication.where: Only the small window-padding expression is repeated, openly, not reshaped.

one_place.where: isOffDay in shared/schedules.ts decides weekend-or-holiday and is used by getDateWithSkippedWeekend (move) and by the daily-skip filters in getNextDate, getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange; every applyWeekendRule caller receives holidays.
